name: depthOfField
description: The viewer's depth of field, as on the blog: a focus distance slider from 2 (near) to 8 (far), default 4, and a blur circle 10 pixels across per unit of |depth - focus| / depth. Each splat is widened by that blur (as a world size) and fades to keep its weight.

source.name: World Labs threeviewer effects (splatterPreFragment.glsl focus blur; blog: focal_diameter 10, focal_distance 2..8, default 4), blog demo parameters

focus.note: blur radius in pixels, as a world size
